pages.alt: An upright number line from 5 down to minus 5. A marker facing up started on minus 2 and has stepped forwards 5 steps. Beside it, the rule: facing up means add, and a positive number steps forwards. Minus 2 plus 5 equals 3.

pages.name: Step it forwards
pages.task: Use the marker to work out −3 + 5.
pages.why: Stand on −3, facing up. 5 is positive, so step forwards 5, through 0, to 2. So −3 + 5 = 2.

pages.name: Adding a negative
pages.text: A negative number steps the marker backwards, down the line. It still faces up, because you are adding. So 3 + (−5) = −2.
